examples.sentence: 他在县城四座城门放下十多根五颜六色的木棒，并定下严格的禁令。

previous.explanation_en: 五颜六色 describes something as multicolored. The paired numbers suggest many varied colors, rather than a literal count of five plus six.

parts.contribution_en: 五 means “five”; 颜 here refers to color or appearance, starting one of the paired number-and-color phrases.
六 means “six” and 色 means “color.” Paired with 五颜, it reinforces the sense of many different colors.
